act8/opening_magma_throat.title: Magma Throat
act8/opening_magma_throat.body:
The stone **opens** like a jaw. It is not a door — it is an ancient **wound** that never scarred. The air smells of sulfur and debt.

Below, something **pulses** red. It asks no name. It charges **presence**.

choices.preview: The heat rises. Without the amulet of the trials, each step takes flesh.

onEnterDiaryTexts: Beyond the throne, the axis does not rise — it descends. The throat of the earth swallows light and returns only heat.

act8/descent_crust.title: Cracked Crust
act8/descent_crust.body:
The crust **groans** under the weight. Veins of lava flash between the cracks — not as a map, as a **threat**.

Every breath arrives **too hot**. Those who descend without magma ward feel the skin learn the price before the name.

choices.preview: The heat tightens; the bridge does not promise an easy return.

act8/brimstone_crossing.title: Brimstone Crossing
act8/brimstone_crossing.body:
Sulfur **paints** the air a sickly yellow. Across the rift, a hall opens over a sea of lava: the **Crucible**.

Here the axis **chooses** who continues. The rest becomes ash with a name.

choices.preview: Hub of the deeps — exploration, forge, and the lord of heat.

act8/hub_magma_crucible.title: Magma Crucible
act8/hub_magma_crucible.body:
The **Crucible** is not a room — it is a **furnace** with a name. Black stone bridges cross a sea of lava; the air burns like a verdict.

Here you descend to **end** the axis — or climb back to the surface, if you still have courage to pretend cold.

choices.preview: Move among black stone bridges; stress rises and the heat answers.
Red current; golems and a toll of flesh.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 29; the river only accepts those who can stand the heat.

choices.preview: Where stone learns to hate.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 31+ and completing the lava river first.

choices.preview: Last oath before the crucible's lord.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 33+ and completing the golem forge first.

choices.preview: Boss of the deeps. True finale.
choices.lockedHint: Three quests, map goal, and level 35 — the crucible does not open early.

choices.text: Light the camp on the crucible rim
choices.preview: Short rest; the heat never truly sleeps.
Prices in gold and scorched skin.
choices.lockedHint: You have not found the stall in the lava veins yet — patrol the map.

choices.text: Climb toward the surface — Graywind Heights
choices.preview: Return to the ice — the axis still links both sides.

choices.text: Climb toward the surface — first snow after the throne
choices.preview: Open the peaks path if you have not camped on the ice yet.

choices.text: Head for the ashes of the sky (act7)
choices.preview: The incomplete ending still waits for those who flee the heat.

act8/magma_merchant.title: Ember Stall
act8/magma_merchant.body: A merchant with **cracked skin** opens a stall on stone still hot. He does not smile. He charges in **gold** what the heat would take in flesh.

choices.preview: Consumable · heal
Consumable · heal
choices.lockedHint: Requires 6 gold and the first purchase done.

choices.preview: Consumable · mana
Consumable · reduce stress
Resource · rest
Resource · rest
choices.lockedHint: Requires 6 gold and the first purchase done.

choices.preview: Relic · luck
Take what gold remains — and the smell of ember.

act8/camp/magma_camp.title: Camp on the Rim
act8/camp/magma_camp.body: The campfire **competes** with the sea of lava. It does not warm — it **reminds** that there is still a choice between rest and ash.

choices.text: Feed the fire with supply (−1 supply)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to feed the fire.

choices.preview: Choose which potion to use.

act8/camp/manage_equip.title: Arm against the heat
act8/camp/manage_equip.body: The ember **flickers**; each buckle seems to **bargain** with the heat. You reorganize what still calls itself **yours**: **weapon**, **armor**, **relics** — small promises that the next step will not be ash.

act8/camp/use_consumable.title: Potions at hand
act8/camp/use_consumable.body: Heat **threatens** the glass. Each sip is a moment of choice between the fire outside and what still remains in the inventory.

act8/lava_river.title: Lava River
act8/lava_river.body:
The river does **not** run — it **licks** the stone. Slow waves of magma mark the path like a hot finger.

Across, silhouettes of stone **breathe** fire.

choices.preview: Lava golems guard the passage.

act8/encounters/lava_river_fight.title: River Guard
act8/encounters/lava_river_fight.body: Two lava golems **rise** from the bank. Their heat is not ambience — it is **intent**.

act8/lava_river_after.title: Bank Claimed
act8/lava_river_after.body: The bank **smokes**. The path to the golem forge opens between cracked stones — still hot, still hostile, **yours**.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The lava river took its toll. The golems fell; the bank still burns underfoot.

act8/golem_forge.title: Golem Forge
act8/golem_forge.body: Hammers **without hands** strike basalt anvils. The forge does not make tools — it makes **hatred** with form.

choices.preview: The forge colossus does not ask permission.

act8/encounters/forge_colossus_fight.title: Forge Colossus
act8/encounters/forge_colossus_fight.body: The colossus **rises** from the anvil. Each step spills slag. It is not a guard — it is the forge's final **product**.

act8/golem_forge_after.title: Forge Silenced
act8/golem_forge_after.body: The forge **cools** one degree. Not enough to live — enough to **advance** to the sulfur altar.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The forge colossus fell. The hammers stopped — hatred lost its anvil.

act8/sulfur_altar.title: Sulfur Altar
act8/sulfur_altar.body: The altar **smells** of rotten egg and oath. Sickly yellow covers the stone. Those who kneel pay; those who fight **also**.

choices.text: Offer faith to the altar (−1 faith)
choices.preview: −1 faith · the altar cleans a thread of corruption
choices.lockedHint: The altar charges faith — you need at least 1.

choices.preview: Combat; the altar opens in violence.

act8/encounters/sulfur_wraith_fight.title: Slag Wraith
act8/encounters/sulfur_wraith_fight.body: A **slag** wraith rises from the altar — heat without body, hatred without skin.

act8/sulfur_altar_after.title: Altar Marked
act8/sulfur_altar_after.body: The yellow **recedes**. At the bottom of the crucible, something large **moves** the lava as if it were a cape.

choices.text: Return to the Crucible — the lord waits

onEnterDiaryTexts: The sulfur altar accepted the price. An ember ring stayed on my finger — and the path to the Magma Lord is open, if the crucible map is too.

act8/encounters/magma_lord_intro.title: Magma Lord
act8/encounters/magma_lord_intro.body:
The lava **rises** in a column. Inside it, a trunk of stone and hatred: the **Magma Lord**. Eyes like furnaces. Voice like a crack.

This is the **floor** of the axis. There is no further step — only victory or ash.
onEnterDiaryTexts: At the bottom of the crucible, the Magma Lord rises. He is not a king — he is heat with will.

act8/victory_crucible.title: Crucible Silenced
act8/victory_crucible.body:
The lord **collapses** into black stone. The lava drops a handspan — enough to breathe without asking the hell's leave.

The axis **closes** the last name. The epilogue remains.

choices.text: Descend into the last silence — the true end

onEnterDiaryTexts: The Magma Lord fell. The crucible still burns, but without will — the axis finally has a floor.

act8/epilogue_true_depths.title: Epilogue — True Depths
act8/epilogue_true_depths.body:
There is no sky here — only **stone** and the certainty that the dungeon **ends**. Silence is not flight: it is **victory** that smells of sulfur.

You carry the floor of the axis in your bones. *(You can **save** from the menu or **start over**.)*

choices.text: Close the diary — the floor of the axis

onEnterDiaryTexts: I descended to where the earth still has a name. The heat charged; the amulet guarded; the lord fell. The silence, this time, is mine.

act8/encounters/wild_lava_golem.title: Lava Golem
act8/encounters/wild_lava_golem.body: A lava golem **blocks** the bridge. Living stone, fire for blood.

act8/encounters/wild_ember_hound.title: Ember Hound
act8/encounters/wild_ember_hound.body: An **ember** hound barks without sound — only sparks. The eyes are living coal.

act8/encounters/wild_slag_wraith.title: Slag Wraith
act8/encounters/wild_slag_wraith.body: Slag **rises** in human form. No skin — only heat and grudge.
